note: NEWS pane of the admin window: a post to the bridge, and from there to Discord and every PDA. Created by OZ_VppMenu.OnCreate under OZ_VppRoot at [0, vpp.paneY]. Names NwTitle, NwBody, NewsHint, BtnNwWhoText and the two button names are read by OZ_VppMenu.c. The title and body fields are wider than vpp.fieldW on purpose: this pane is one column across the whole window, and a headline typed into 260 units would be unreadable.

frame.name: PaneNews
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open tab's pane and hides the rest.

label.name: NwHelp1
label.text: A post goes to the bridge and from there to Discord and every PDA. Title, body, and whose name signs it.

field.name: NwBody
field.note: The post itself. 12 lines is what the 214-unit box holds at the fixed 14-point field face.

label.name: NwHelp2
label.text: Click to cycle: your own name, then every persona the bridge lists for you.

label.name: NewsHint
label.note: Empty: every answer of the news route lands here.
